column1: Note: The categories, sub-categories, and service activities listed in this document represent the current project scope and requirements. However, considering future business growth and real-world operational needs, any additional categories, sub-categories, service activities, workflows, fields, forms, or functional requirements identified during implementation or post-launch operations may be incorporated through future upgrades, enhancements, or customization requests. The platform architecture shall be designed with sufficient flexibility and scalability to accommodate such additions without impacting the core functionality of the system.
